== English Virtual Original comparison ==
October conditions the earlier geographic Force-drain protection on Tawss being at a battleground. The remaster raises deploy to 3, removes the power and drain boosts and narrows protection to the battleground planet site and Sergeant Doallyn’s site. The later rulebook example quotes those words.
